annotations.title: Benny Andersson: The Iconic Piano Riff
annotations.instruction: Keep wrist supple and low across the 6 flats/sharps. Balance the singing soprano melody line above the pulsating accompaniment.

sections.title: Intro: Benny Andersson Piano Riff
sections.character: Iconic rolling arpeggios and emotional descending melody

sections.title: Verse 1: I Don't Wanna Talk
sections.character: Vocal cantabile line, gentle syncopated broken chord accompaniment

sections.title: Chorus 1: The Winner Takes It All
sections.character: Soaring soprano cantabile with deep bass resonance

sections.title: Verse 2: I Was in Your Arms
sections.character: Deep emotional sincerity, building dynamic drive

sections.title: Chorus 2: The Loser Has to Fall
Dramatic Bridge: Does She Kiss Like I Did?
Fortissimo Double Climax Chorus

sections.title: Fading Outro & Peaceful Resolving Chords
